scope: Original Chanhua, Ronghua and Bian embroidery photo groups; follow-up to PR #14
authorization: User requested completing website product galleries from their original brand photo library. Originals are read-only; no generated or third-party photos added.
correction: First pass missed original heritage photos because the brand library directory had been renamed. This inventory supersedes the initial heritage missing-photo assessment.
processing: EXIF orientation corrected; RGB WebP quality80, max edge1280 without upscaling, EXIF/GPS not copied; original visible marks preserved.

notes: CH-01 and former CH-02 depict the same six-berry U-shaped hairpin. They are now merged as CH-01, with edited-only photographs.
CH-03 is the red three-leaf tulip; CH-04 is the pink three-leaf tulip with a pearl-edged leaf and dangling pearl. Their photos are not cross-attached.
Exclude duplicated raw/edited exports, repeated near-identical poses, derivative marketing layouts, making photos, unrelated finished pieces, and pair/group shots containing a different tulip colour.
Red handheld June photo excluded because its mounted pin details cannot be verified against the final photographed brooch.
chanhua.reviewStage: Initial original-photo review before user-confirmed consolidation; current gallery configuration is recorded in products and followUp.

notes: 268 supplied raster files reviewed in root and 5 subfolders; original camera/design files remain untouched.
Posters that merely repeat the same product photograph, duplicate resized versions and maker/workshop scenes excluded. No watermark removal or generative modification.
Former RH-13 is merged into RH-01 as one blue floral accessory supporting hair and brooch uses. The confirmed gallery views are retained together.
Former RH-12 is merged into RH-11 as one violet floral piece supporting brooch and vase uses. Its worn, held and vase views are retained together.
RH-10 remains one image: source169 shows a pair of birds and source170 a production batch; cannot establish which is the exact single bird held in primary168. No new true alternate verified.
Root sources0–48 and51–82 show other designs not represented by the initial 23 reference records before consolidation and are not attached as extra views.
RH-23 alternate224 shows reverse/open mechanism of the same black hair claw (opposite-side flowers account for different visible counts); 222 and225 near-duplicate this view, 226 repeats cover223.
Optimization: EXIF transpose, RGB WebP quality80 method6 maximum edge1280, no upscaling, no EXIF/GPS copied.
ronghua.reviewStage: Initial original-photo review before user-confirmed consolidation; current gallery configuration is recorded in products and followUp.

notes: Other bag variants, printed marketing collages, generated composite images and duplicate resized copies excluded.

The initial exact-object review excluded LE-01 group and colour-variant photos. The user subsequently requested all colours: the current LE-01 gallery now explicitly includes the three-colour family, labelled by colour/view.
Initially unassigned lion reverse photos were excluded. The current colour-variant gallery uses reverses identified within the selected three-colour source group; other lion designs remain excluded.
Near-identical dragon vase full views and paired-panel repeats excluded.
embroidery.reviewStage: Initial original-photo review before user-confirmed consolidation; current gallery configuration is recorded in products and followUp.
